## Episode Thesis

Episode #495 of VG's Norwegian personal-finance podcast Pengerådet is mostly about fund costs and consumer prices. DNB launched a 'whole world' index fund (90% global, 10% emerging markets) at 0.1% a year, Storebrand matched the price the next day, and Finansportalen's fund comparison now counts transaction costs. On markets, the hosts discussed Nvidia jumping 30-40% after Jensen Huang's surprise return as CEO, fears of an AI bubble, and a weaker krone softening losses for Norwegian investors; value funds such as Skagen Global have recovered. The second half covers Black Friday shopping with a tech.no journalist. There are no Nordic stock picks.
